model_composition: raw-student-probability-only; no teacher, M7 blend, morphology, or line fitting
selection_basis: Highest fixed-T=0.35 frozen macro Dice among eligible checkpoints at >=150k; ties to later. Selected after full 250k completion.
inference_basis: Family primary fixed before any scoring (F0_FAMILY_PREREG_20260908.md): the frozen 200k weights with eight-way mirror TTA. Operating point = argmax of the fixed-threshold frozen macro Dice over the two pre-registered thresholds {0.30, 0.35}; no other threshold was considered, no per-variant calibration, nothing tuned on PHerc1447.

selection.rule: Highest fixed-T=0.35 frozen macro Dice among eligible checkpoints at >=150k; ties to later. Selected after full 250k completion.

paired_delta_vs_reference.method: paired cluster bootstrap, clusters = support_anchor_chunk_zyx (PHerc0814 256 clusters, PHerc1451 142), 2,000 resamples, seed 20260908, identical resample weights for both audits

inference.verdict: breaks-0.70-candidate (needs C3r replication, 0500P2 floor, repair re-qualification)
